name: B1 unknown-reference finite comparison v1
selection: separately by resource type, minimize mean absolute pseudo-event window residual normalized by pre-fixed q on selection users only
calibration: 90% split score: one maximum absolute normalized pseudo-window residual per calibration user; separate resource; finite rank ceil((n+1)*0.9); infinite if rank exceeds sample count
features: temperature available before notice by simulation declaration
excluded_features: remaining energy reconstructed from future endpoints
primary_metrics: test event reference window RMSE in kW
test event reference window bias in kW
auxiliary_metrics: test pseudo-event absolute normalized window error
test pseudo eta >0.1 fraction (not a response detection false positive rate)
limits: RIDE synthetic EV and AC generators only; no real validation
pseudo EV windows intentionally retain charging beyond task; real event natural ends may differ
calibration score exchangeability and pseudo-to-event transfer not established by conformal formula
20 seeds are independent blocks; paired temperature variants not 40 independent blocks
do not increase repetitions or tune after seeing main scores
